meta.title: Bulk Consolidate Across PRs: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Set up or verify the tenant is on the Growth plan.
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and inspect or attempt Bulk Consolidate Across PRs across multiple PRs.
Repeat the same bulk-consolidation attempt as a Buyer and compare availability or refusal in the same tenant.
Record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

steps.note: Reach the Purchase Requisitions area where consolidation across PRs would be initiated.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer and then the Buyer in the same Growth tenant, attempt Bulk Consolidate Across PRs across multiple PRs in both sessions, and record whether the action is absent, refused, or available

steps.note: The required personas, tenant plan, and bulk-consolidation action are not controllable or observable through the catalog.
